lessons_used: Home wait_info changes are helpful, with 4 winning tests out of 7.
Adoption redesigns are helpful, winning both tests with strong positive results.
Choose_path copy updates and redesigns showed no positive effect, ranging from no clear effect to performing worse across 2 tests each.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns showed no positive effect, ranging from no clear effect to performing worse across 2 tests each.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), finish new flows (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were systematically too low for winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative results; evidence remains thin for single-test categories.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Trait Preview Wait Display
candidates.change: Add a pet trait preview component on the waiting screen to showcase upcoming companion behavior while the pet renders.
candidates.why: Home wait_info changes are historically strong performers (4 wins out of 7), and pet generation has a high median duration of 201s.

components.text: Your companion's unique personality traits are being compiled.

guard.reason: Adding pet trait previews on the waiting screen enhances information without removing any required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info features have proven historical success (4/7 wins, +2.0% avg lift) mitigating the long 201s wait time.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Checklist Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a structured checklist stage layout to clarify upload requirements.
candidates.why: Adoption stage redesigns have a 100% win rate in past tests, and custom pet generation errors are a top support issue.

guard.reason: replacement for 'upload_photos.photo_upload' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['photo_picker'] with real words

candidates.title: New Companion Personality Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new interactive personality quiz screen right before friend selection to let users pick companion temperament.
candidates.why: Adoption flow additions boost user investment in pet creation and adoption completion rates.

new_personality_quiz.headline: Shape Your Pet's Temperament
new_personality_quiz.body: Select primary traits to customize how your pet interacts on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a personality quiz screen into the onboarding order is allowed and keeps all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has a 19.2% drop-off rate; however, introducing a new screen requires high engineering effort with modest expected lift.

candidates.title: Home Intro Stage Desktop Action Guide Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro completion screen into a stage layout focusing on desktop action controls.
candidates.why: Support messages highlight confusion around controlling, hiding, and talking to the pet after completing onboarding.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Animation Sound Preview
candidates.change: Display an animated mascot preview with interactive sound effects while background pet creation finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait_info features consistently improve user retention during long waiting steps.

guard.reason: Adding animation and sound preview components to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Interactive media during wait time aligns with proven home wait_info test wins (+2.0% avg lift).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Two Column Stage Layout
candidates.change: Switch the adoption certificate screen layout to a two-column view pairing official registration with pet traits.
candidates.why: Adoption step structural improvements consistently produce strong positive test results.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Desktop Pet Registration
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion's certificate of adoption before entering home.

guard.reason: Updating the adoption certificate layout while retaining registration content is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has strong redesign precedent (+9.6%), though layout changes specifically have thin historic data.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Desktop Guide Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the final onboarding screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing immediate desktop pet shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails cite confusion on how to control or hide pets on the desktop after setup.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Here are key controls to interact with, move, or minimize your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Reframing the home intro layout to show desktop shortcuts is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High evidence score due to explicit support email feedback combined with a 17.6% finish step drop-off.

candidates.title: Adoption Companion Voice Preview Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive pet voice sound test sub-flow directly inside the pick friend companion selection screen.
candidates.why: Adding interactive preview elements during adoption increases adoption completion confidence.

guard.reason: Adding a sound profile preview component to the friend selection screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sub-flow additions require full flow changes (cost 0) with unproven lift for adoption voice previews.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Companion Activity Timer Display
candidates.change: Show a visible countdown timer and animated mascot on the waiting screen to set clear expectations during pet synthesis.
candidates.why: Home wait_info interventions show strong performance in testing history.

guard.reason: A countdown timer on the waiting screen is allowed as it represents a real wait during pet synthesis.

candidates.score_note: Low cost timer display on waiting screen leverages reliable home wait_info pattern (+2.0% historical avg).

candidates.title: Story Path Intro Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder the starting screen sequence by showing path choice first before the story introduction.
candidates.why: Allows users to quickly specify their onboarding path (median 8s) prior to engaging with story narrative.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

picked: Home Intro Spotlight Desktop Guide Layout
Waiting Screen Companion Activity Timer Display
